tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List candidate Spark event-log runs from a local directory or a Spark History Server, before diagnosing one with the other tools.

tools.name: diagnose_run
tools.description: Diagnose a Spark run: the dashboard verdict (title, summary, and the top places to look, ranked by stage task time or idle core time, then potential savings, each with its lead finding), findings, an impact-ranked fix recommendation rollup, and the writeTargets, metrics and effectiveConf blocks of the CLI report. view "compact" (the default) lists one short row per finding and leaves out the clean-check and not-checked lists; view "full" returns every finding with its remediation text and evidence, and those lists. Every finding row has a key that stays the same for the same finding in a rerun of the job (compare_runs rows list the same keys), and an id for get_finding_evidence. With format "md" the content is Markdown, and structuredContent holds it as markdown next to a few headline fields. A JSON result longer than 50000 characters comes in pages: pass pagination.nextCursor as cursor, with the other arguments unchanged, for the next one. When the server was started with --thresholds, findings and clean checks from a tuned detector carry tunedThresholds, and their impact estimates are uncalibrated. The result names the Spark application (app) and the build that wrote it (generator). runId is a handle for the run this server process has cached. It differs per tool by design (compare_runs returns runIdA and runIdB, evaluate_budgets the runId of its first run) and per server process, so match runs by app.id and app.attemptId, not by runId.

view.description: compact (default): one short row per finding. full: the CLI report's rows, clean checks and not-checked checks.

minBand.description: List only findings at this band or a more severe one.

maxFindings.description: List at most this many findings, most severe first. findingsOmitted counts the ones left out; each verdict step still carries its lead finding.

cursor.description: The pagination.nextCursor of the previous page. Not used with format "md".

tools.name: get_run_summary
tools.description: App/stage/job/sql counts, duration, and how the run ended (failed/total jobs and Spark's first-line failure reason) for a run, no findings.

tools.name: compare_runs
tools.description: Compare two runs: the verdict, metric deltas (metrics), categorized findings delta (findings), the stage pairs (stagePairs) with the share of executor run time they cover (runtimeCoverage), and comparability: the configuration differences, plan equality, data volume, executor capacity and the factors that bridge the wall-clock difference. confidence is ok, low or insufficient. metricDeltas and findingsDelta repeat metrics and findings under their earlier names and will be removed. The result names both Spark applications (baselineApp, candidateApp) and the build that wrote it (generator). Each findings row lists its stage names in stages and the same names without call-site directories in stageLabels. runId is a handle for the run this server process has cached. It differs per tool by design (compare_runs returns runIdA and runIdB, evaluate_budgets the runId of its first run) and per server process, so match runs by app.id and app.attemptId, not by runId.

include.description: Extra blocks to return. stagePairs: one row per paired stage with its deltas, which can be large.

normalizePath.description: Regular expressions whose every match in a plan node's text is replaced with a fixed token before stages are paired, so run-specific text (an output directory that differs per run) does not keep the same stage from pairing. A generic pattern, not only for paths. Affects stage pairing, runtimeCoverage and confidence, never findings. A pattern that backtracks catastrophically can stall the server: keep them simple and anchored.

ignoreConf.description: Regular expressions matched against Spark configuration keys. A key that matches is left out of comparability.conf, for keys that differ by design such as a per-run output path. Per-run identity keys (application id, start time, driver address) are always left out.

noiseBand.description: Share of the baseline value under which a metric row is marked withinNoise (default 0.02). Never changes a row's direction.

tools.name: evaluate_budgets
tools.description: Evaluate a run against pass/fail thresholds, optionally against a baseline run for regression budgets. With two runs, absolute budgets apply to the candidate (sourceB/runIdB), matching the CLI. A run with no ApplicationEnd always adds an inconclusive run-complete result, and a run with skipped log lines an inconclusive parse-incomplete result. runId is a handle for the run this server process has cached. It differs per tool by design (compare_runs returns runIdA and runIdB, evaluate_budgets the runId of its first run) and per server process, so match runs by app.id and app.attemptId, not by runId.

source.description: The run to evaluate. When sourceB/runIdB is given, this is the regression baseline instead, and the absolute budgets apply to sourceB/runIdB.

runId.description: Same as `source`, referencing an already-resolved run by id.

sourceB.description: Optional candidate run, compared against source/runId as the regression baseline (maxRegressionPct/failOnIntroduced). When given, the absolute budgets (maxRuntimeMs etc.) are evaluated on this run.

runIdB.description: Same as `sourceB`, referencing an already-resolved run by id.

regressionBudgets.description: Further regression budgets, one per metric (the CLI's repeated --regression-budget). A metric can be budgeted once across this list and maxRegressionPct/regressionMetric.

stageRegressionBudgets.description: Per paired stage (needs sourceB/runIdB): fail when any eligible pair's metric (executorRunTime, executorCpuTime, memoryBytesSpilled, diskBytesSpilled, shuffleReadBytes, shuffleWriteBytes) regressed by more than maxPct. One entry per metric. Inconclusive when no stage pairs.

stageQualities.description: Pair qualities the stage budgets read. Default exact and structural: an aligned pair may compare different work.

tools.name: get_finding_evidence
tools.description: Raw evidence bundle backing one finding, for drill-down after diagnose_run. Pass the runId of the diagnosis. When the runId is not cached (after a server restart), pass the source of the run, as for diagnose_run, and optionally its appId: the run is analysed again and the findingId stays the same.

appId.description: The application the source must hold. Needs source.

tools.name: get_finding_documentation
tools.description: Detection and tuning reference documentation for one finding type (not tied to a specific run), so a client without browser access can read the same background material the web view links to.

tools.name: get_reference_doc
tools.description: Full tuning-reference chapter or bottleneck markdown by doc anchor (e.g. "#joins", "#bottleneck-skew", "#metric-task-duration"), so a client without browser access can read the same reference the web view shows.
